description: Returns the best posts of a Threads account this member connected, ranked by engagement (likes + replies + reposts + quotes) or by views, likes, replies, reposts or quotes, with each post's text and metrics from MindThread's insights cache. Other people's accounts cannot be read: the Threads API only returns insights for the authorized user's own posts. Applies when the user wants to study what worked on their own account, for example to write a content document. 繁中：只讀會員自己連結的帳號，依互動排序取表現最好的貼文。

account_id.description: Account id from list_accounts (only accounts this member connected)

days.description: Only posts from the last N days, 1-365 (omit = all fetched posts)

name: get_top_posts
title: Get top posts
